chatbot.title: Virtual assistant
chatbot.subtitle: Answers to frequently asked questions
chatbot.welcome: Hello! I can answer common questions about the services and the demo appointment form. This is an FAQ assistant with prepared answers, not an open-ended AI. Messages are not sent or stored. Please do not enter real personal or health information.
chatbot.appointmentQuestion: How do I request an appointment?
chatbot.appointmentAnswer: On the booking page, you can select a service, date and time, then submit a demonstration request. This does not confirm an appointment with a real clinic.
chatbot.servicesAnswer: The Services page lists the demonstrated services. This content is illustrative; only a qualified dentist can assess what is appropriate for an individual.
chatbot.confirmationAnswer: No. The form is for demonstration and does not confirm an appointment with a real clinic.
chatbot.demoAnswer: SmileCraft Dental is a fictional portfolio concept, not a real clinic. Do not enter real personal or health information.
chatbot.medicalAnswer: I cannot diagnose or recommend treatment. Please ask a qualified dentist for advice; seek urgent medical care for emergency symptoms.
chatbot.contactAnswer: The phone, address and email on the Contact page are fictional demo details, not real clinic contact information.
chatbot.fallbackAnswer: I don't have a prepared answer for that. I can help with the demo form, the services shown, or whether a request is confirmed.
